content:
rachel (partnerships): Heads up — CloudMart just onboarded to our marketplace connector and their first two days of usage look inflated. paging @tom @priya.

meter-bot: Ingest alert: new partner stream cloudmart-prod shows 2.7x expected daily volume at 2026-03-05T08:00Z.

tom (eng): can you share an example event? curious if it's a unit mismatch (seconds vs tokens) or duplicate batches.

rachel (partnerships): pasted redacted sample they provided:
```json
{"account":"acct-987","ts":"2026-03-04T23:00:00+08:00","unit":"calls","quantity":1800,"meter_id":"cm-001","batch_seq":null}
{"account":"acct-987","ts":"2026-03-05T00:00:00+08:00","unit":"minutes","quantity":30,"meter_id":"cm-001","batch_seq":null}
```

priya (finance): why are there two units in same feed? that will break aggregation rules. We bill per-call not per-minute for this partner.

tom (eng): looks like CloudMart aggregates both backend RPC calls (unit=calls) and customer session durations (unit=minutes) into same meter_id. Our ledger treats quantity as homogeneous — hence double-counting.

alex (acctmgr): CloudMart's onboarding doc said they would send 'calls' only. SI said they added a sticky session metric last-minute. they didn't mention batch ids.

priya (finance): short-term mitigation: we should map 'minutes' -> calls via partner-specified conversion factor, or drop non-billable units until we agree. Need an auditable tag for dropped events.

tom (eng): propose this triage: 1) Ingest transform to normalize units: if unit==minutes and partner==cloudmart then convert quantity -> quantity * 60 and unit->calls (configurable mapping) 2) Require partner to emit batch_seq or batch_id to avoid duplicates 3) Add ingest metric: unit_mismatch_count per partner 4) Flag & quarantine any events with unknown unit for manual review.

rachel (partnerships): I'll ask CloudMart to confirm conversion factor and send a change request to SI. @alex can you own partner comms?

alex (acctmgr): yep will ping them now. quick note: we need to decide whether to backfill prior days after conversion. finance, thoughts?

priya (finance): backfill ok if conversion is deterministic and we can produce a delta report. if uncertain, we should not auto-credit/debit customers. require partner sign-off + audit CSV.

tom (eng): implementation details: update marketplace-ingest to add partner unit map (yaml). sample config:
```yaml
partners:
  cloudmart:
    unit_map:
      minutes: {to: calls, factor: 60}
    require_batch_id: true
```

meter-bot: Runbook check: if batch_id missing for >12h and unit conversion applied, alert @rachel and set ingest.quarantine=true.

rachel (partnerships): vendor replied — they confirm minutes represent session minutes and agree to factor=60. SI needs 5 business days to update SDK.

priya (finance): fine. action items: staging convert+replay for last 48h and produce ledger delta. if delta < $1k, do automatic backfill; otherwise manual review.

tom (eng): starting staging patch now. will emit metric cloudmart.unit_mismatch_count and quarantine count. ETA deploy in 2h.

meter-bot: job deploy/marketplace-ingest-cloudmart-staging queued -> started (job id: deploy-5092).

tom (eng): staging ingest ran on sample: unit_mismatch_count=342, conversion applied to 320 events, quarantine=22 (unknown unit variants like "sess_min"). logs: https://staging-logs/internal/deploy-5092 (internal).

priya (finance): please upload ledger delta by EOD tomorrow. i'll review and sign off on backfill policy.

alex (acctmgr): told partner to roll SDK update and include batch_id going forward. also requested a signed statement for the conversion factor.

rachel (partnerships): summary & owners: tom -> implement mapping + metrics (in progress), alex -> partner comms + signed factor, priya -> ledger delta review, me -> monitor ingest.quarantine and escalate if >0.5% of daily volume.

meter-bot: deploy/marketplace-ingest-cloudmart-staging -> success (job id: deploy-5092) in 00:02:58.

tom (eng): will open follow-up thread with ledger replay results and attach replay script. closing this thread. :white_check_mark:
